# Python reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Reading data

Every reader returns the same container, so nothing downstream can tell which format the data arrived in.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [read](read.qmd#falconage.read) | Dispatch on the filename. Convenience, not magic -- it says what it chose. |
| [read_betas](read_betas.qmd#falconage.read_betas) | Read a beta matrix from CSV, TSV or parquet. |
| [read_series_matrix](read_series_matrix.qmd#falconage.read_series_matrix) | Read a GEO ``*_series_matrix.txt.gz``: metadata and betas in one file. |
| [read_clinical](read_clinical.qmd#falconage.read_clinical) | Read a clinical chemistry table. |
| [read_rrbs_dir](read_rrbs_dir.qmd#falconage.read_rrbs_dir) | Assemble several RRBS files into one matrix on their shared sites. |
| [FalconData](FalconData.qmd#falconage.FalconData) | A scoreable dataset. |

## Preprocessing

Getting a matrix into the shape every clock assumes: bare probe identifiers, values in the beta range, a known platform. The EPIC v2 step is mandatory rather than optional -- without it a v2 dataset overlaps almost nothing and the clocks score imputed values.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [prepare](prepare.qmd#falconage.prepare) | The standard chain: harmonise ids, collapse v2 replicates, clip, identify. |
| [prepare_clinical](prepare_clinical.qmd#falconage.prepare_clinical) | Rename to canonical markers and convert to the units the models expect. |
| [qc](qc.qmd#falconage.qc) | Look at the data before scoring it. |
| [probe_loss](probe_loss.qmd#falconage.probe_loss) | What each clock has lost on this dataset, before scoring anything. |
| [preprocess.aggregate_replicate_probes](preprocess.aggregate_replicate_probes.qmd#falconage.preprocess.aggregate_replicate_probes) | Strip EPIC v2 probe suffixes and collapse the replicates. |
| [preprocess.impute](preprocess.impute.qmd#falconage.preprocess.impute) | Dataset-level imputation, applied before any clock sees the matrix. |

## Scoring

The predict loop, its result object, and the provenance it carries.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [score](score.qmd#falconage.score) | The scoring loop and its result object. |
| [combine](combine.qmd#falconage.combine) | Stack per-dataset results into one, for a benchmark across studies. |
| [FalconResult](FalconResult.qmd#falconage.FalconResult) | Scores plus everything needed to say where they came from. |

## The clock catalogue

161 clocks in three availability tiers. Twenty-eight are scaffolds whose coefficients are research-use-only; the registry says which, why, and what open clock answers the same question.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [registry.load](registry.load.qmd#falconage.registry.load) | Load the packaged registry. Cached for the life of the process. |
| [registry.ClockRegistry](registry.ClockRegistry.qmd#falconage.registry.ClockRegistry) | Loaded catalogue. Immutable except for user-registered local weights. |
| [registry.Clock](registry.Clock.qmd#falconage.registry.Clock) | One registry entry. |
| [registry.register_local_weights](registry.register_local_weights.qmd#falconage.registry.register_local_weights) | Supply a coefficient file for a clock FALCONAge does not distribute. |

## Analysis

Age acceleration in its three conventions, association and survival models, reliability, and the AA1/AA2 benchmark. Each is gated on the clock's scale type -- acceleration on a pace-of-aging clock is a units error, not a conservative choice.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [acceleration](acceleration.qmd#falconage.acceleration) | Age acceleration, in whichever of the three conventions you mean. |
| [cell_composition](cell_composition.qmd#falconage.cell_composition) | Cell-type proportions estimated in this same run, as a covariate frame. |
| [associate](associate.qmd#falconage.associate) | Ordinary least squares of each clock on an outcome, adjusted for covariates. |
| [cox_hazard](cox_hazard.qmd#falconage.cox_hazard) | Univariable Cox hazard ratio per clock, by Breslow-tied partial likelihood. |
| [agreement](agreement.qmd#falconage.agreement) | Between-clock correlation. |
| [icc](icc.qmd#falconage.icc) | ICC(2,1): two-way random effects, absolute agreement, single measure. |
| [run_benchmark](run_benchmark.qmd#falconage.run_benchmark) | The AA1 and AA2 tests, and the score that combines them. |

## Clinical references

KDM and homeostatic dysregulation have no fixed coefficients: both are defined relative to a reference cohort, and the manifest records which.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [models.fit_kdm](models.fit_kdm.qmd#falconage.models.fit_kdm) | Fit the KDM reference regressions. |
| [models.fit_hd](models.fit_hd.qmd#falconage.models.fit_hd) | Estimate the healthy reference centre and covariance. |
| [models.clinical.phenoage](models.clinical.phenoage.qmd#falconage.models.clinical.phenoage) | Clinical Phenotypic Age in years. |

## Figures and reports

Every plot returns its data as well as its figure, which is how the two languages draw the same numbers with different engines. `clock_atlas` is the exception in scale rather than in kind: one figure covering every clock across every pooled study, for the case where a per-clock panel would need forty of them.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [plot.ba_vs_ca](plot.ba_vs_ca.qmd#falconage.plot.ba_vs_ca) | Predicted against chronological age, with the identity line. |
| [plot.bland_altman](plot.bland_altman.qmd#falconage.plot.bland_altman) | Difference against mean, with bias and 95% limits of agreement. |
| [plot.calibration](plot.calibration.qmd#falconage.plot.calibration) | Residual against chronological age. |
| [plot.acceleration_density](plot.acceleration_density.qmd#falconage.plot.acceleration_density) | Histogram of acceleration, optionally split by group. |
| [plot.acceleration_by_group](plot.acceleration_by_group.qmd#falconage.plot.acceleration_by_group) | Box and strip of acceleration by group -- the case/control workhorse. |
| [plot.acceleration_heatmap](plot.acceleration_heatmap.qmd#falconage.plot.acceleration_heatmap) | Clocks by samples, z-scored within clock. |
| [plot.forest](plot.forest.qmd#falconage.plot.forest) | Effect size and 95% interval per clock/dataset comparison. |
| [plot.kaplan_meier](plot.kaplan_meier.qmd#falconage.plot.kaplan_meier) | Survival of the fastest-ageing tail against the slowest. |
| [plot.volcano](plot.volcano.qmd#falconage.plot.volcano) | Effect size against evidence, for a table from :func:`~falconage.associate`. |
| [plot.clock_corr](plot.clock_corr.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_corr) | Correlation heatmap, hierarchically ordered. |
| [plot.clock_radar](plot.clock_radar.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_radar) | Closed-polygon profile across clocks, one polygon per group. |
| [plot.clock_chord](plot.clock_chord.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_chord) | Circos-style chord diagram of CpG sharing between clocks. |
| [plot.clock_pca](plot.clock_pca.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_pca) | Samples embedded in clock space. |
| [plot.clock_atlas](plot.clock_atlas.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_atlas) | One figure comparing every clock across every pooled study. |
| [plot.coverage_bar](plot.coverage_bar.qmd#falconage.plot.coverage_bar) | Per-clock feature coverage. The plot to read before the scores. |
| [plot.missingness](plot.missingness.qmd#falconage.plot.missingness) | Distribution of per-sample missingness. |
| [plot.beta_density](plot.beta_density.qmd#falconage.plot.beta_density) | Per-sample beta distribution. |
| [plot.platform_comparison](plot.platform_comparison.qmd#falconage.plot.platform_comparison) | Score distribution split by array platform. |
| [plot.study_comparison](plot.study_comparison.qmd#falconage.plot.study_comparison) | Score distribution split by study. |
| [plot.benchmark_bars](plot.benchmark_bars.qmd#falconage.plot.benchmark_bars) | AA2 and AA1 counts per clock, ordered by the combined total. |
| [plot.benchmark_error_bias](plot.benchmark_error_bias.qmd#falconage.plot.benchmark_error_bias) | MedAE against MedE, sized by the benchmark total. |
| [plot.benchmark_heatmap](plot.benchmark_heatmap.qmd#falconage.plot.benchmark_heatmap) | Effect size per clock and dataset, with significant cells outlined. |
| [plot.palette](plot.palette.qmd#falconage.plot.palette) |  |
| [plot.save_all](plot.save_all.qmd#falconage.plot.save_all) | Render every figure this result can support and write it as PNG. |
| [report.write_report](report.write_report.qmd#falconage.report.write_report) | Render one self-contained HTML file for a scoring run. |

## Downloading public data

Accession in, files and a normalised sample table out. Credentialed archives are documented rather than automated -- the access agreement is the user's, not the tool's.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [download](download.qmd#falconage.download) | Fetch public data from an accession. |
| [download.cache_info](download.cache_info.qmd#falconage.download.cache_info) |  |
| [download.clear_cache](download.clear_cache.qmd#falconage.download.clear_cache) | Delete the download cache. Returns the bytes freed. |
